subject: Carnatic Music (Melodic Instruments)

source.title: Carnatic Music (Melodic Instruments), Code 032, Classes XI-XII (2026-27)

internalBreakdown.component: Internal assessment: project file 5, project work 5, periodic practical tests 10

notes: Theory 30 marks (2 hours) without a unit-wise split; practical 50 (external examiner); internal assessment 20.

units.name: Theory: History and Theory of Indian Music

chapters.name: Lakshana Granthas (Class XII)
topics: Sangita Saramrita, Sangita Sampradaya Pradarsini, Swaramelakalanidhi, Ragavibodha, Brihaddesi

chapters.name: Musicians and Composers (Class XII)
topics: Annamacharya, Swati Tirunal, Kshetrajna, Maha Vaidyanatha Iyer, Patnam Subramanya Iyer, Ramnad Srinivasa Iyengar, Mysore Doraiswamy Iyengar, Dwaram Venkataswamy Naidu, Karaikudi Brothers, Mysore Vasudevachar

chapters.name: Terms (Class XII)
topics: Janaka-janya system, bhashanga, upanga, varja, vakra ragas, arudi, eduppu, jati, grama, murchchana, jaati

chapters.name: Ragas and the Instrument (Class XII)
topics: Brief description of prescribed ragas; kirtana notation
Construction and playing technique of the instrument; classification and history

chapters.name: Ragas and Compositions (Class XII)
topics: Purvikalyani, Todi, Sri, Simhendramadhyamam, Bhairavi, Shanmukhapriya, Keeravani, Nata, Ritigaula, Saveri

chapters.name: Varnam, Manodharma and Pallavi (Class XII)
topics: Ata tala varnam in two speeds
Alapana and kalpana swaras in Adi, Rupaka, Chapu
Simple pallavi in Adi or Khanda Triputa
